answer.recommendation: Order 3 boxes of compatible tips (standard or low-retention). Base need is 24 experiments x 80 tips = 1,920 tips. Adding the 10% reserve gives 2,112 tips. Since boxes contain 1,000 tips, 3 boxes (3,000 tips) are required, leaving 888 tips above the reserved requirement.

Reserve applied as 1,920 x 1.10 = 2,112 tips, which is rounded up to whole boxes: ceil(2,112 / 1,000) = 3 boxes.
Only the compatible types listed in the packet (standard, low-retention) are recommended.

I did not have access to the visible experiment plan file or contact any colleague, so the figures were not cross-checked against the plan itself; if the plan differs from the packet, the quantities should be re-run.
